claims: As of April 2, 2026, NASA’s Artemis II mission has launched.
As of April 2, 2026, NASA’s Artemis II mission is currently orbiting Earth.
NASA’s Artemis II mission has a four-person crew.
The Artemis II crew is preparing to travel around the Moon on a 10-day mission.
Artemis II marks the first human trip to the lunar vicinity in over 50 years.
The Artemis II crew will splash down in the Pacific Ocean.
The Artemis II spacecraft will perform a fly-around of the Moon before returning to Earth.
The Artemis II spacecraft will reach distances farther than any human has gone before.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Jeremy Hansen are on board Artemis II.
The Artemis II crew will spend about 10 days in space to test the Orion capsule’s life support systems.
Artemis II prepares for Artemis III.
Artemis III plans to land astronauts on the moon in 2028.
